title: Cross-Chain Profit Hunter
description: A whale systematically exploits price differences across BSC, Ethereum, and Arbitrum, generating consistent profits with minimal directional risk.

agent_reasoning.reasoning: 7% spread between ARB and ETH. After bridge fees (~1%) and gas (~0.5%), net profit ~5.5% per cycle. Highly profitable.
Using Across Protocol for fast bridging (2min). Low slippage. This is professional-grade infrastructure.
Directional risk is near zero — simultaneous buy/sell. Only risk is bridge failure or price change during 2min bridge time.
34 cycles with 94% success rate (32/34). 2 failures were due to bridge congestion, not price movement. Consistent edge.
